H01-04: Inspection of <title> and <h1> tags for existence, uniqueness, and descriptive content.
Pass: <title> and exactly one <h1> exist and contain non-generic text.
Fail: Missing, empty, or generic <title> or <h1>, or multiple <h1> tags found.
1. Check if <title> exists, is not empty, and is not a generic term (e.g., "home", "untitled").
3. Check if <h1> text is not empty and not a generic term.
If the <title> tag is missing or empty:
- Add a descriptive <title> tag to help users identify the page in browser tabs.
If the <title> text is too generic:
- Change the generic title to a descriptive format (e.g., "Page Name - Site Name").
If the page is missing an <h1> tag:
- Add exactly one descriptive <h1> tag to indicate the main content of the page.
If there are multiple <h1> tags on the page:
- Keep only the most important <h1> tag and convert the others to <h2> or appropriate lower heading levels.
If the <h1> text is too generic:
- Update the <h1> text to clearly and specifically describe the page's actual content.
